## Background

I earned my bachelor's degree in computer science from Delhi Technological University. I then moved to the United States, where I completed a master's degree in information systems. My professional journey began as a data analyst at a manufacturing company, where I applied data science techniques including time series forecasting, predictive modeling, and machine learning. I later joined Discover (Capital One), where I held roles as a business intelligence analyst and subsequently as a software/data engineer.

## Why data science

Throughout my career, I found myself increasingly drawn back to the data science work I had enjoyed earlier on. Recognizing this, I decided to pivot by enrolling in UBC's Master of Data Science program. My goal is to transition into a full-time data scientist role.

## Outside of data science

Outside of work, I enjoy playing the piano, reading science fiction, and playing video games.
